content: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally in the wild, and there are a mind-boggling number of things to do in Leonida. Many of them are terribly dangerous, like stealing cars from the police impound lot, getting into high-speed chases, and laundering stolen goods. But GTA 6 has plenty of wild and wacky optional activities too, many of which include references to pop-culture icons, past Rockstar games, or well-known memes. Here are a few of the coolest Easter eggs we've discovered in our own playthroughs and from other players on social media.
